name: L
source:
"I've just successfully graduated, and my student life ends today..."

The protagonist looks back on his four years of student life, busy with classes, club activities, part-time jobs, and many other things.

"...I realized that I actually didn't know much about the city and the people who lived there."

Until his new life begins, he takes a short two-week break and starts walking around town, taking in sights both familiar and unfamiliar.

"Let's go out into the city and look for new memories..."

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ006803.html/?unique_op=af&utm_medium=affiliate&utm_source=none]DLSite[/url]]
